name: Course sequence and workload review
summary: A course lead revising an outline for the next cohort gets a module map: learning goals, prerequisites, activities and the instructor's own time estimates, with crowded weeks and coverage gaps marked and every gap written as a question. The course lead decides what changes.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of the work of reviewing a course outline for the next cohort, and the rules written from how that work is done.
